tier_wrapper.conclusion: All five actual wrappers select the target weakspot-rending template. Four families request 2/4/6/8 layers per I–IV; Dual Shivs requests 1/2/3/4. Target debuff is .025 rending per layer, 5 seconds, target cap 16; no attacker self-rending field was inferred.

content_review.trigger_and_refresh: Actual event requires held source item, matching source item, weakspot hit, Minion target, and target alive at processing; no attack-type or positive-HP gate was inferred. Source helper request cap 31 is separate from target debuff cap 16. At target cap, admission refreshes start time and emits max-stack-refresh without adding a physical stack. The accepted Force Sword correction accurately states jump/dodge can interrupt actual M1/M2 sticky paths, while a separately configured exit Attack occurs only on qualifying dodge with actor/unit and non-resim conditions; three scheduled hits are not guaranteed after early exit. M3 active-cleave remains separate.
